Hadith.4093 - A man said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):
"I entrusted a man with wealth, or I deposited it with him, but he betrayed me and denied having my wealth."
Imam (as) said: "The trustworthy one did not betray you, but rather, you entrusted a traitor."
